Mantel and Partial Mantel Test for Omics-Environment Associations

Source: R/stat_mantel.R
cli_mantel.Rd

Evaluates association between biological community or module distance matrices and environmental factor distance matrices using matrix permutations. Supports partial Mantel tests to control for confounders such as geographic distance, sample collection batch, sequencing depth, or subject age.

Usage

cli_mantel(
  comm_data,
  env_data,
  dist_comm = c("bray", "jaccard", "euclidean", "manhattan"),
  dist_env = c("euclidean", "manhattan"),
  method = c("pearson", "spearman"),
  n_perm = 999,
  partial_data = NULL,
  by_variable = TRUE,
  seed = 42
)

Arguments

comm_data

Numeric matrix or data frame of community abundances, module profiles, or an existing dist object (samples in rows, features in columns).

env_data

Numeric matrix or data frame of environmental variables, clinical traits, or an existing dist object (samples in rows, variables in columns).

dist_comm

Dissimilarity metric for community data: "bray" (default), "jaccard", "euclidean", or "manhattan".

dist_env

Dissimilarity metric for environmental factors: "euclidean" (default) or "manhattan".

method

Correlation method between distance vectors: "pearson" (default) or "spearman".

n_perm

Integer. Number of permutation iterations to evaluate statistical significance (default 999).

partial_data

Optional matrix, data frame, or dist object of confounding covariates to condition upon for partial Mantel testing.

by_variable

Logical. If TRUE (default), tests each environmental variable individually in addition to the overall multivariate environmental matrix.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducible permutations.

Value

A data frame containing:

  • variable: Environmental factor name (or "All_Variables").

  • statistic: Mantel correlation coefficient \(r\).

  • pvalue: Two-sided permutation p-value.

  • padj: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR-adjusted p-value.

  • signif: Significance asterisks (* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001).

  • method: Test designation ("Mantel" or "Partial_Mantel").

References

Mantel N (1967). The detection of disease clustering and a generalized regression approach. Cancer Research, 27(2): 209-220.
